distributions.ubuntu.releases.description: List of Ubuntu releases to support

distributions.ubuntu.sourceslist.default:

deb-src http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu %(release)s-security main universe restricted multiverse

deb http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ %(release)s-updates main universe restricted multiverse
deb-src http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ %(release)s-updates main universe restricted multiverse
